name: Customer Evidence to Roadmap
description: Moves from customer research evidence to a reviewed roadmap recommendation with traceable assumptions and explicit decision ownership.
purpose: Create a roadmap recommendation grounded in customer evidence and make uncertainty and trade-offs explicit.
trigger: A product team has customer research and needs to evaluate roadmap options.

inputs.name: interview-notes
inputs.description: Approved customer interview notes and references

outputs.name: roadmap-recommendation
outputs.description: Sequenced options, rationale, dependencies, risks, and open decisions

steps.name: Synthesize evidence
steps.purpose: Identify themes, contradictions, and confidence levels in research.
acceptance_criteria: Material themes link to source evidence
steps.on_failure: Block downstream prioritization if core evidence is missing.

steps.name: Prioritize opportunities
steps.purpose: Compare opportunities using explicit criteria and evidence strength.
acceptance_criteria: Scores are not presented as objective truth
steps.on_failure: Return for clarification when evidence is insufficient.

failure_handling.response: Preserve the conflict and request a decision on the source of truth.

observability.evidence_and_logs: Retain source references, assumptions, and output versions at each handoff.
observability.completion_reporting: Report completed and blocked steps, unresolved decisions, and approver.

definition_of_done: Recommendation links material claims to evidence
Accountable decision owner approves or records a rejection

compatibility.notes: This example is a playbook contract, not an automated runtime configuration.
